newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow in Kansas on Thursday. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Inquiry good, demand moderate, USDA said.

Sales confirmed on 5,700 slaughter steers and 5,700 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 94,200 head confirmed including 29,000 head or about 31 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1170-1250 lbs 65.00; load Select with end Choice 64.75.
Dressed Basis Few Select and Choice 2-3 1350 lbs 105.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 65.00.
week to date: 94,200 last week: 81,300 last year: 27,100
